summary: Dismantled and sold for steel in the early 1980s; known from one Former Fire Lookout Sites register entry, with no site description today.

facts.status_note: Dismantled in the early 1980s and the steel sold for beams; no source describes what remains.

events.note: Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on June 30, 2026

evidence.supports: The Description section is the register's only account of the site; it says nothing about the site today

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLOS register entry, whose description reads like a volunteer's account; the nominator is not named here. Two web searches and the NB archives community page and Wikipedia article found nothing on the tower. No year is given for the build (late 1950s to early 1960s) or the removal (early 1980s), so no dated events are recorded for them. The 80 ft figure is the entry's overall height; it is not confirmed whether that includes the cab. Access and what remains on site are unknown. The entry says the Blackville tower still stands; not checked.
